In the background, a large multi-story building stands behind a field, framed by trees with orange and yellow foliage under bright daylight. (2) The man stands beside another man wearing a black blazer with a white crest logo. The blond man throws the handful of yellow leaves into the air so they shower down over both of them. He laughs excitedly while the man in black remains relatively still and stoic. The setting is a park-like environment with dense autumn trees. (3) The blond man interacts playfully with the other man, pointing at him and leaning in with expressive facial gestures. Both men are captured in a medium full shot, showing their contrasting outfits and the vibrant autumn background. (4) The man in the black blazer picks up the blond man on his back for a piggyback ride. They move away from the camera's original position, and the blond man laughs heartily, gesturing toward the lens as they travel along the path.
